kinds.theme: shadcn theme variable (filled by the chosen preset)
kinds.tailwind: Tailwind v4 theme key (filled by the tailwind-default namespace)
kinds.component: shadcn component variable (default from the upstream component)
kinds.style: shadcn style axis: a fixed nova class bound to this variable with the style's own value
kinds.extension: variable shadcn lacks, named by shadcn convention; default copied from today's fill
kinds.moved: not a token contract key; lives on the named surface

tokens.color-ramp.note: Read-only engine row of Color; presets author role values from ramps, components never read a ramp.
